name: Ca duoi hap
summary: Cá đuối hấp hành is stingray steamed with onion. Dân Việt says diners also eat the fatty liver. The broth of a ray hotpot is a different plate.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, on the town streets.
howToEat: Share it at lunch or dinner. The story does not say rice or bún.
